name: colibri
description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
one_liner: Lets a regular computer run enormous AI language models by streaming only the parts it needs straight from disk, instead of requiring a rack of expensive GPUs to hold the whole model in memory.
buyer: A developer or small AI startup that wants to run a frontier-scale open-source model locally, without paying for cloud GPU inference or buying server hardware.
business_use_cases: An indie AI app avoids per-token cloud inference bills entirely by running the model locally on the user's own machine.
A hospital or law firm runs a large model on-premises for data-sensitive work, since nothing ever leaves their own hardware.
A hobbyist or small studio runs a top-tier open model on a Mac mini or gaming PC instead of renting a costly GPU instance.

money_ideas.idea: Package a one-click installer/GUI appliance for non-technical local-AI users and sell it as a license
Offer paid setup and hardware-sizing consulting for businesses wanting to self-host large models cheaply

steal_this: Build a friendly one-click installer/GUI wrapper around it this weekend and sell it to the 'local AI' hobbyist community as a $20 app.
